**Best move:** Re5+

**Main line:** Re5+ Kh6 Rh4#

**Motif:** fork (the rook on e5 checks the king and attacks the bishop simultaneously, forcing the king to h6 where it gets mated)

**Coaching note:**

When your rook controls the 5th rank, check for back-rank mating patterns. Re5+ forces the king to h6—the only legal move—because it's simultaneously checking the king and attacking the bishop, leaving no escape squares. Then Rh4 is mate; the king is trapped by its own pawns. Always scan for forcing checks that limit the opponent's options to just one or two replies.
